newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch KLM and Northwest to start new U.S. service.
newsitem.headline: Dutch KLM and Northwest to start new U.S. service.

text.p: Dutch carrier KLM said on Monday it was expanding its joint North Atlantic service with U.S. partner Northwest Airlines Corp with a daily return flight to Newark, New Jersey, from Amsterdam.
"The new service marks a further strengthening of the KLM-Northwest operational partnership," KLM spokesman Hans Leijte said.
The service, to be introduced from May 1 next year, will be operated using Northwest DC-10 aircraft.
Leijte said the Newark service would further bolster the airlines' position in the lucrative New York market.
KLM and Northwest already jointly serve New York's John F. Kennedy airport with twice-daily flights to and from Amsterdam's Schiphol airport.
